conclusion: At c952e845db the full native Windows install rule copies the configured downloaded uv executable into resources/tools/uv, while InstallOnlyInlong.cmake copies source resources and omits that downloaded executable. The Windows build-tree staging also has no uv copy. PythonInterpreter::bundled_uv_path first tries the configured absolute INLONG_BUNDLED_UV_EXECUTABLE path, then resources/tools/uv and executable-local tools/uv. The configured path exists on this development machine and masks the portable-output gap; unavailability is conditional on all three candidates being absent. For this local installation, copy the exact configured uv 0.11.21 into the filtered package resources/tools/uv and Release/tools/uv, verify its hash against the full package/configured tool and run --version in all three locations. Do not write through Release/resources because it is a source-resource junction. The source recipe remains unchanged, so a later recreation needs the same supplement. No network package installation or interactive plugin UI was tested.
